cluster_summary: The cluster contains vulnerabilities in DNS handling within a network library that uses a proxy trust model. The primary defect is performing DNS pinning (hostname resolution and IP binding) before checking whether a trusted proxy is active, which bypasses proxy security controls and can lead to SSRF, information leakage, and authorization bypass. Additional sub-patterns include DNS rebinding due to separation of hostname validation and fetch, and several unrelated DNS issues.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-controlled URLs or server-controlled redirect responses into HTTP clients that automatically follow redirects or reuse a previously validated URL decision. Report code paths where the final redirected scheme, host, port, and resolved address are not revalidated before the sensitive network request. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 11 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should disable automatic redirects or revalidate every redirect hop against the same allowlist and address policy.

mechanism.missing_guard: the final redirected scheme, host, port, and resolved address are not revalidated before the sensitive network request
mechanism.name: SSRF through redirect-following client
mechanism.sink_shape: HTTP clients that automatically follow redirects or reuse a previously validated URL decision
mechanism.source_shape: attacker-controlled URLs or server-controlled redirect responses
mechanism.typical_fix: disable automatic redirects or revalidate every redirect hop against the same allowlist and address policy

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Move DNS pinning resolution into the else branch so it only executes when not using a trusted proxy mode, ensuring the proxy's DNS resolution takes precedence.
sub_patterns.name: unconditional DNS pinning before trusted proxy mode check
sub_patterns.root_cause: Code performs DNS pinning resolution unconditionally before evaluating whether a trusted proxy is active, causing the pinned IP to be used even when the proxy should handle DNS resolution, bypassing proxy security controls.

sub_patterns.name: premature DNS pinning before proxy mode check
